analysis_md:
用复合函数的求导法则：

$$\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial w}{\partial u}\cdot\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial v}\cdot\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=vu^{v-1}\cdot1+y\cdot u^v\cdot\ln u$$

即有 $xy(x+y)^{xy-1}+y(x+y)^{xy}\ln(x+y)$

$$\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial w}{\partial u}\cdot\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial v}\cdot\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=vu^{v-1}\cdot1+y\cdot u^v\cdot\ln u$$

即有 $xy(x+y)^{xy-1}+y(x+y)^{xy}\ln(x+y)$
